title: Arnold Fixed Point Bound by Cup Length
exact_target: Does every Hamiltonian diffeomorphism of a closed connected symplectic manifold $M$ have at least $\operatorname{cl}(M)$ fixed points, where $\operatorname{cl}(M)$ denotes its cup length?
